function: Channel estimation for a flexible intelligent metasurface: predicts the channel at any target FIM shape from M noisy pilot-shape measurements (p. 5).
system: BS with 8x8 flexible intelligent metasurface (morphing UPA of radiating elements, not a reflecting RIS), K=4 single-antenna UEs, TDD, 28 GHz mmWave (p. 3, 5, 13).
method: Hierarchical Fourier neural operator (U-shaped FNO), supervised training with MSE loss on synthetic data; fine-tuning for larger arrays (p. 11-14).
data_channel: Synthetic clustered mmWave multipath channel (L=5 clusters, G=6 paths) said to follow 3GPP TR 38.901; 20,000 training samples, 500 Monte Carlo test trials (p. 4, 13).
test_conditions: Trained on 8x8 array, deformation 0.5 lambda, 5 clusters; tested on 10x10 to 14x14 arrays (zero-shot and fine-tuned), 0.25 and 1.0 lambda, 20 clusters (p. 14-15).
baselines: Nearest-neighbor, KNN and kernel ridge regression interpolation, OMP and sparse Bayesian learning, all classical; no earlier learned estimator compared (p. 13).
metrics: NMSE versus SNR and pilot overhead (p. 13); zero-forcing sum-rate versus SNR (p. 14).
complexity: Order of complexity only: inference O(L d_v N log N), training O((Ns/Bs) L d_v N log N) per epoch; no runtime, FLOPs or parameter count (p. 12).
q1_support: p. 4: "Following the mmWave channel modeling in 3GPP [31]"
q2_support: p. 14: "trained on an FIM with a specific size N = 8 × 8, can be directly applied to FIMs of various other sizes from N = 10 × 10 to N = 14 × 14 without retraining"
q3_support: p. 13: "comparing it against several model-based benchmarks"
q4_support: p. 12: "the total inference complexity is approximately O(Ldv N log N )"
notes: Included, area 2. ris=0 because the FIM is the BS's own morphing transmit array of radiating elements (p. 1-3), not a reflecting or transmitting surface in the channel; reviewer may confirm. q1 is borderline: the paper says its clustered model follows 3GPP TR 38.901 (p. 4, ref. [31] on p. 16), but the simulation uses a power-law path loss with exponent 2.2 and CN(0,1) small-scale gains (p. 4, 13) and no 38.901 scenario or profile; marked met only on the rule that a simulator the paper says is built on a 3GPP model counts, reviewer to confirm. q3=0: Figs. 5-7 (p. 13-14) compare only Nearest, KNN, KRR, OMP, SBL and the proposed H-FNO; KNN and KRR are interpolation fitted per sample and presented as model-based (p. 5-7), and no earlier learned estimator or standard network is compared. q4: asymptotic order only (p. 12). q5: synthetic data, no link, DOI or code statement anywhere in the paper.
